chains.trait: Boneless pelvic tails & horizontal quadrupedal posture
links: post-catastrophe nutrient influx fuels rapid lipid storage
low gravitational stress on limb joints favors sprawling weight distribution
stable axial tilt eliminates seasonal foraging scarcity

skill.effect: The creature draws upon its thick fat reserves to soften blows, leaving it visibly winded but quickly recovering its strength. It slowly heals its wounds over a short while as it metabolizes its stored energy.

chains.weakness: Fat metabolism produces heat; prolonged use causes overheating in dry biomes
observe: Pelvic regions swell into thick, muscular fat-ridges
Locomotion is horizontal and sprawling, using forelimbs for balance
Tails twitch rhythmically during social gatherings and rest

journal.en: Gravity relaxes; flesh piles on, turning posture horizontal.

plausibility.summary: Reframe Lipid Reserve as stamina/ healing from fat stores after injury, not literal damage absorption; link sprawling posture to display and even weight on saturated substrates (F8), not F2 alone.

chains.trait: Ritualised communal pleasure & festival-driven social cycles
links: high humidity and stable climate reduce territorial resource competition
nutrient-rich bacterial manna yields constant caloric surplus
post-catastrophe population boom requires rapid social cohesion

skill.effect: The creature engages in rhythmic movements and vocalizations that lift the spirits of those nearby, making them feel united and calm. This festive atmosphere strongly discourages any sudden altercations among the group.

chains.weakness: Predictable mating/festival windows allow enemies to ambush gathering sites
observe: Groups gather in open clearings for extended, synchronized social rituals
Cranial vasculature dilates visibly during peak social interaction
No personal shelters; communal sleeping mats dominate settlements

journal.en: When survival is guaranteed, pleasure becomes the primary economy.

plausibility.summary: Tie festival windows to bacterial manna bloom pulses (F15) so predictability is ecological, not arbitrary; keep sentient culture as driver of ritual scale.
fixes: Tie festival windows to bacterial manna bloom pulses (F15) so predictability is ecological, not arbitrary; keep sentient culture as driver of ritual scale.

chains.trait: Muscular fat tail as dynamic counterbalance and display
links: High fecundity and energy surplus from high O2
Horizontal posture distributes weight along spine
Tail evolves as counterweight and display organ

skill.effect: The creature swings its heavy muscular tail with surprising force, often sending close attackers stumbling backward. It also carries itself with such confident grace that it strongly sways opponents in negotiations.

chains.weakness: Tail is highly vascular and vulnerable to crushing; requires constant high-calorie intake

journal.en: A tail to balance the weight of a life lived in the moment.
